title: Stop the old scope when a shell restarts (pty:restart) or a kept shell is not adopted on restore
notes: Left by #257 (docs/processes open questions). (1) A shell started again through pty:restart gets a new scope and the old one keeps running. (2) A kept shell that pane.restore does not adopt is killed but its scope is never stopped. Both leave a dev server or watcher running. Route both through the same stopScope port pane.close and project.close use, through the pane actions (actions-rule-1); decision tests; hand check on throwaway scopes only. Docs: docs/processes, history.

comments.body: Shipped in #260: pane.restart (Enter on an exited pane, and a dispatch starting a shell over) stops the old shell's scope; pane.restore stops the scope of a kept shell it kills. In-app hand check on throwaway scopes not done.
Pull request #260 merged: Stop the old scope when a shell restarts or a kept shell is not taken back https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/260
